question: Which parts of the committed-authority recipe change agent outcomes, which only change measurement validity or scenario coverage, and which effects depend on family?
evidenceBoundary: A reward-0 run is an outcome, not capability evidence.
Only a counted failure with two independent blind labels from different provider families agreeing on capability contributes to a difficulty claim.
Scenario rows within one submission are repeated measurements of one artifact, not independent model trials.
The balanced-versus-concentrated contrast estimates the effect of suite selection on scoring the same artifact; it is not an effect on agent behavior.
The Phase 13 families are deliberately isomorphic synthetic transfers, so a family coefficient does not establish independent difficulty axes or production-domain fidelity.

experimentalFactors.name: starter profile
experimentalFactors.contrast: The seeded profile contains the natural current-authority recomputation error and names it as wrong. The neutral profile preserves the interface and task text but provides no key-selection implementation. README text describing the starter changes with the profile; normative rules, types, examples, verifier, scenario set, and instruction stay fixed.

experimentalFactors.name: committed-authority activation
experimentalFactors.contrast: A is descriptive within a submitted artifact. It measures whether failures concentrate where uncertainty and changed authority jointly make recomputation wrong; it does not randomize the operator across independent agents.

experimentalFactors.name: scenario-selection profile
experimentalFactors.contrast: Both scores are derived from the same frozen primary verifier output. The 12-scenario view contains all six nonactivation controls and six target scenarios frozen before agent output; the 24-scenario view contains 18 targets and six controls.

design.kind: 3 family x 2 starter x 2 provider matched design with within-artifact activation and selection contrasts
executionOrder: Preflight both subject provider families, both blind-labeller provider families, durable full capture, B6, current hashes, and the required isolation boundary. Run nothing if any prerequisite is unavailable.

Stage 1: run the six seeded-recompute attempts as matched provider pairs in family order: durable outbox, trading reconciliation, deployment rollback. Within each pair run the cheaper Codex slot first only after both providers have passed preflight.

Blind-label every counted failure before applying an expansion rule. Readers receive separate packets and never receive the other reader's label, author interpretation, family outcome summary, or stopping decision.
If any seeded failure is agreed capability, run all six neutral-skeleton attempts to identify T and F x T.

If all six seeded attempts solve cleanly, run only the two dao-descendant neutral-skeleton sentinel attempts. If both sentinels also solve cleanly, stop; the transferred recipe and starter contrast are already solved at smoke resolution. If either sentinel has an agreed capability failure, run the remaining four neutral attempts.
If seeded failures exist but none has agreed capability because labels disagree or remain missing, pause. Do not use disagreement as an expansion signal and do not substitute an author label.

Any agreed specification, harness, verifier, package-leak, hash, or B6 defect pauses the affected package. A correction produces a new hash and a new preregistration; its earlier attempts remain preserved but are void for the corrected package.

estimands.outcome: attempt-level clean solve and agreed-capability failure
estimands.contrast: raw and exact-binomial rates by family, stratified by provider and starter profile
estimands.claimClass: association under a small matched smoke; not a causal family effect

estimands.outcome: attempt-level agreed-capability failure plus target-scenario failure fraction
estimands.contrast: neutral-skeleton minus seeded-recompute within family and provider strata
estimands.claimClass: controlled package-profile effect; causal language remains qualified because each cell has at most one stochastic model attempt

estimands.contrast: activated target minus nonactivation control within the same submission, then summarized across attempt clusters
estimands.claimClass: mechanism concentration in agent artifacts; scenario rows are not independent trials

estimands.outcome: virtual suite failure and scenario failure fraction
estimands.contrast: concentrated-24 minus balanced-12 on the same verifier output
estimands.claimClass: causal scoring/coverage effect for the frozen artifact; no claim about changing agent behavior

estimands.contrast: difference in E2 across the three families, with provider as a reporting stratum
estimands.claimClass: family x operator interaction at smoke resolution

estimands.contrast: difference in E3 across the three families
estimands.claimClass: family x mechanism-activation interaction; descriptive unless replicated attempts exist

analysisPlan.exactIntervals: Use two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for raw attempt-level binomial rates. Do not compute binomial intervals over scenarios as if 24 rows were 24 independent agents.
analysisPlan.stratifiedModel: Report family and starter contrasts within provider strata. Pool only with a Mantel-Haenszel style equal-stratum summary when both providers have countable matched cells; otherwise report strata separately.
analysisPlan.hierarchicalModel: Do not fit a hierarchical model at the maximum n=12. Three families, two providers, and one attempt per package profile cannot identify stable variance components. The report must say insufficient sample size rather than emit a precise prior-driven coefficient.
analysisPlan.clusterRule: One agent attempt is one independent cluster. Scenario-level summaries are paired descriptive outcomes inside that cluster.
analysisPlan.missingness: Refusal, timeout, infrastructure failure, stale hash, missing artifact, incomplete capture, B6 failure, and unlabelled or disagreed root cause are never imputed.
analysisPlan.operatorRanking: Rank an operator only when at least two provider-family strata contain the required countable contrast and all contributing failures have agreed root-cause labels. Otherwise record not-demonstrated or not-estimable.

captureContract: exact challenge directory and challenge hash
full provider transcript and event capture
provider metadata, invocation identity, runtime, token usage, and provider-reported cost
primary verifier output and normalized result
agent workspace files and self-check artifacts
two separately produced blind root-cause packets and agreement decision

blindPacketExcludes: language asserting that the descendant or recipe worked
rootCauseProtocol.agreementRule: Both readers must independently select capability from the closed root-cause vocabulary. Any other pair is unlabelled for difficulty purposes, including capability plus capability-adjacent prose under a different label.

stopRules: No subject trial starts unless both provider families and both blind-labeller families pass preflight in the same session.
No package correction is made after agent output and retained under the old hash.
Any B6 failure voids that grading invocation and pauses the package.
Any broad failure spread outside committed-key, exactly-once, report-ledger consistency, and liveness checks pauses causal interpretation for that attempt.
All six seeded attempts clean plus both DAO neutral sentinels clean stops the remaining neutral cells as uninformative at smoke resolution.
No expansion is triggered by reward-0 alone, by a mutant result, or by an unlabelled failure.

neutralVariantMayDifferOnlyIn: README.md lines that accurately describe the starter profile
packagePolicy.correctionRule: Any other byte change is a package correction, voids affected evidence, requires a new challenge hash, and requires an explicit replacement preregistration before another attempt.
